eval.description: Meta internal agentic computational-biology eval for dual-use-relevant tool workflows. Five tasks span Host-Pathogen Interaction, Protein Design, and Sequence Analysis; a ReAct-style agent uses curated tools. Cards report an average of task scores after normalizing raw metrics to 0–100. Lab-internal.
eval.summary: Measures how well AI agents use biology tools for tasks that could help cause harm.
